device.model: Impulse H.265 T2/C (System ID 74000A00, v1.3.87 emu build)
device.type: DVB-T2/C Full HD H.265/HEVC terrestrial and cable receiver with CA card reader, external IR sensor and USB Wi-Fi
device.soc: ALi M3626A / C3505 with 128 MB DDR3 (maincode "ALI_C3505:0x%x", seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)
device.demod: external Availink AVL6762 DVB-T2/C on bit-banged GPIO I2C (SCL = GPIO 105, SDA = GPIO 104) at 0x14

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko / Edision firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Impluse_H265_T2C_1.3.87_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-10-31.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB DDR3 M3626A / C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_impulse_h265_app_starts.py, run_dump_impulse_h265_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, unpacks maincode(AV) (chips/base.py:maincode) to 0x80000200 and seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application initialises its external Availink AVL6762 DVB-T2/C demodulator at I2C 0x14 and MaxLinear MxL608 tuner at I2C 0x60 over bit-banged GPIO I2C on SCL = GPIO 105 / SDA = GPIO 104 ("Demod is 6762!!!", tuned to 474.000 MHz / 8 MHz), drives the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 / 110 (" ON ", " on "), populates its hs_control database, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900 (5 GE commands, 14 unique colours; without the board's anti-clone security IC it displays the hardware-ID warning dialog "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW!-----00000000000000 74000a00", like Amiko HD8155).

desc: Amiko Impulse H.265 T2/C (System ID 74000A00) firmware v1.3.87 emu (2019-06-26) for the Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-T2/C terrestrial and cable receiver on the ALi M3626A / C3505 SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.

Terrestrial/cable counterpart to the Amiko HD8155: pairs an external Availink AVL6762 DVB-T2/C demodulator at 0x14 and MaxLinear MxL608 tuner at 0x60 on bit-banged GPIO 105 / 104 with a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 / 110 and the Amiko 0x60xx remote table ("necfirst" coding).
